title: Schedule type times moved into their own editor modal
summary: Creating a new schedule type (or clicking Edit on an existing one, including Regular Day and Lunch's own times) now opens a dedicated modal showing just that type's period-time cards, instead of one giant grid on the main Settings screen showing every period for every schedule type at once.
The old inline Period Times section and its wall of cards are gone from Settings -- the Schedule Types list there now just has a name and an Edit button per type.
Creating a new schedule type opens straight into this editor instead of a browser prompt() for the name.
